whyThisBuild: Latest stable 9.0.x patch on the gyan.dev release branch. Essentials contains all codecs Catalyst needs (H.264/H.265/VP9, MP3/AAC/Opus/Vorbis/FLAC, MP4/MKV/MOV/WebM muxers) without the extra libraries pulled into the full variant. Stay on release builds for distribution; do not use git-master nightlies.
howToUpdate: See docs/RELEASING.md (FFmpeg pin update). Never change zipUrl without updating zipSha256 + expectedVer + THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md in the same commit.

previousPin.note: Build shipped during development (ffmpeg 9.0.1-essentials_build-www.gyan.dev, gcc 16.1.0). Superseded by 9.0.2 for the first public Windows beta.
